data.credibility: Management frequently guides clearly and hits customer addition targets, such as reaching 119.3 million customers in FY26. However, they sometimes miss specific growth targets like MSME or FY26 AUM growth, and occasionally drop or stop mentioning unfulfilled tech and cost targets.

lines.line: Full year credit cost guidance of 1.85% to 1.95% was dropped without actual reporting.
Promised 22-23% AUM growth for FY26 but missed with actual 18.1%.
Cost of funds guidance of 7.5% to 7.55% was dropped after a brief raise.
Delivered 17.5 million new customers in FY26, successfully meeting the 17-18 million target.
Promised 10-12% MSME growth for FY26 but missed as actual growth hit 18.1%.
Plan to go live with 80 FinAI areas by Feb 2026 was dropped.
Gold loan target of INR 27,000 to 30,000 crores by March 2027 remains on track.
Crossed 119.3 million franchise in FY26, keeping the 120 million customer goal.
Target to reach 200 million customers in 3 to 4 years was dropped.
Consumer AI platform target by May-June 2027 was dropped.
Target of 800+ autonomous agents in the next fiscal was dropped.
Customer addition target of 15 to 17 million for FY27 is on track.
AUM growth target of 20% to 24% for FY27 is slipping against actual 20.7%.
ROA target of 4.4% to 4.6% for FY27 is on track.
ROE target of 19% to 20% for FY27 is on track.
Credit cost to AUM target of 1.45% to 1.60% for FY27 is on track.
Opex to NTI improvement target of 25 to 40 bps for FY27 is on track.
Gold loan branch target of 2,700 to 2,800 is slipping with 2,022 actual branches.
Digital platform target of INR 50,000 crores business is pending.
Volume target of INR 100,000 crores next year is pending.
Disbursements via AI bots of INR 11,000 to 12,000 crores are pending.
New loans target of 60 to 62 million for FY27 is pending.
Agentic applications target of 180-odd applications for FY27 is pending.
Fee income growth target of 15% to 18% is on track with 20.7% actual.
FY30 target of INR 11 lakh crores is pending.
Medium-term growth guidance of 20% to 25% is on track with 20.7% actual.

bull: Net profit compounded at 34.3% over five years, supported by trailing net profit of ₹22,066 cr on revenue of ₹90,331 cr.
Customer franchise successfully expanded to 119.33 million in FY2026, hitting customer addition goals of 17.5 million new users.
Fee income growth is on track at 20.7%, aligning with medium-term guidance of 20% to 25% growth.
bear: FY26 AUM growth missed expectations, coming in at 18.1% against a targeted 22-23%.
Gold loan branch expansion is slipping, reaching only 2,022 branches compared to the year-end target of 2,700 to 2,800 branches.
Management frequently drops unfulfilled operational and technology targets, such as abandoning the 80 FinAI areas plan.
